format: Doubles are IEEE-754 binary64 bit patterns in hex (decimal gives the shortest round-trip form for reading); a string that is not UTF-8 is given as <FIELD>_BASE64.
source: Expected bytes are the output of the GP archive importer's original Go builders (buildGPArchiveMPE / buildGPArchiveCAT, space-data-network 70c9d4884, sdn-server/cmd/spacedatanetwork/import_gp_archive.go) for the same inputs; real vectors are sampled from the archive at /opt/data/sdn-archive (Space-Track GP history, gp_history windows, daily gp snapshots, SATCAT).
